## SegmentedRendererOptions type

Configuration options for the segmented control renderer. Activated when `segmented: true` is set on a UI schema element's options.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type SegmentedRendererOptions = StandardRendererOptions & {
    segmented: true;
    data: {
        value: string;
        label: string;
        color?: string;
    }[];
};
```
**References:** [StandardRendererOptions](./foundation-forms.standardrendereroptions.md)
